task: Find the top game listed in the Steam Deck's top-played list over the past year. Then, browse reviews for that game from players who have played over 100 hours and primarily use a Steam Deck.
agent_final_answer:
Top game on the Steam Deck Top Played list over the past year (Jun 4, 2025 - Jun 3, 2026) is "Slay the Spire 2".

I opened its store page and filtered Customer Reviews by Playtime = "Over 100 hours" and "Played mostly on Steam Deck". 106 reviews match these filters, with an overall "Very Positive" rating. Each matching review shows the Steam Deck icon next to playtime.

Sample of browsed reviews (100+ hrs, Steam Deck):
- DaMightyJex (164 hrs) - Recommended: "Fantastic game and fantastic sequel to the original... characters feel fun and unique... new Epoch timeline reward system felt like a large improvement... new multiplayer mode adds even more fun."
- PowerSpike (118.9 hrs) - Recommended: "Love this game, got to A10 on all 5 characters and I hope we get more in the future."
- Floods Man (215.5 hrs) - Recommended: "Gotta give this a recommendation. Don't listen to the haters who don't understand how early access works."
- Vahtos (106.3 hrs) - Recommended: "Really great. Needs some balance, but that's to be expected. Co-op mode is so good."
- Suske (171.8 hrs): "Ignore Chinese review bombing, git gud."
- ccru (276.8 hrs), Nellcromancer (142.7 hrs), 67 enjoyer (117.2 hrs), Boatdoken (103.5 hrs - "Even better than the first one, and coop is just mega fun").
- ChickenPowder (144.3 hrs) - Not Recommended: critical of a recent update.

Overall, long-time Steam Deck players are largely positive, praising the sequel's new characters, the Epoch reward system, and the new co-op/multiplayer mode, while noting it is still in Early Access and needs balance work; a minority are negative over recent updates and reference review bombing.
